versions.subject: Fix Further FPs Found In Testing (#4564)
versions.detection:
selection_findstr:
    - CommandLine|contains: findstr
    - Image|endswith: 'findstr.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'FINDSTR.EXE'
selection_cli_search_subfolder:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /s '
        - ' -s '
selection_cli_search_insensitive:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' /i '
        - ' -i '
condition: selection_findstr and all of selection_cli_search_*
versions.spl: CommandLine="*findstr*" OR Image="*findstr.exe" OR OriginalFileName="FINDSTR.EXE" CommandLine IN ("* /s *", "* -s *") CommandLine IN ("* /i *", "* -i *")
